quantity: factor between Gaia DR3's RUWE of a single star and the RUWE this package's unbinned mode (simulate_fit with binned=False and uwe_factor=1) simulates for it, by G: the median archive RUWE of the stars of a band over the median simulated RUWE of the same stars
sample: gaiadr3.gaia_source, astrometric_params_solved = 31, non_single_star = 0, parallax > 0.1 mas, nu_eff_used_in_astrometry and ruwe not null, no cut on RUWE; the 700 stars of each band of 0.25 mag from G 9 to 16 with the lowest random_index; 19,600 stars, none of them in gaiadr3.nss_two_body_orbit
simulation: each star once, in its own position, G, parallax and nu_eff, with no companion (a1_au = 0), the DR3 window, binned=False and uwe_factor=1, seed the index of the star in the sample sorted by G; the binned mode with its default calibration, for the check
fit: f of a band is the median archive RUWE over the median simulated RUWE of the band's 700 stars; the factor is the linear interpolation between the band centres and holds the end value below G 9.125 and above G 15.875, where the sample ends
check: fitted on 350 randomly chosen stars of each band (seed 17290) and tested on the other 350 of each band against the binned mode with its default calibration: the two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic D of the RUWE against the archive's is 0.097 for the unbinned mode with this factor and 0.237 for the binned mode on the 9,800 stars of the test half; the unbinned mode is closer in 28 of 28 bands and worse in none (each by more than a bootstrap standard error of 200 resamples); with the halves exchanged D is 0.095 and 0.238, 28 of 28 bands. The width of the RUWE distribution (16th to 84th percentile) is 0.268 against the archive's 0.278 (binned mode 0.116); the share of stars above RUWE 1.4 is 0.008 against the archive's 0.103 (binned mode 0.000): the factor does not reproduce that tail
bands_note: band centres are the nodes of the linear interpolation; the table is fitted on all 19,600 stars; tests/golden/single_stars_dr3.csv.gz holds them with the halves of the check marked fit and test
